trust_decision.summary: An authored CMS/mail Twig template is untrusted input: rendering it must never reach PHP execution, theme/file writes or unrestricted DB writes, and that is decided for every attribute/method access by System\Twig\SecurityPolicy::checkMethodAllowed (and checkSecurity) inside the sandboxed Twig environment built by MarkupManager::makeBaseTwigEnvironment.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the CMS SecurityPolicy and a blocklist bypass, so a reader looks first at the $blockedMethods table (the largest hunk of the published fix) and expects a one-file change there.

fix_sites.entry_point: MarkupManager::makeBaseTwigEnvironment() - builds the CMS, mailer and .htm-view Twig environments
every sandboxed render: CMS page/layout/partial/content, backend mail templates, .htm views
any template calling a Twig function (source(), constant(), enum_cases())
any template method call on any object (this.page.*, this.theme.*, model.*)
fix_sites.module_kind: sandbox policy method check + forwarding model

fix_sites.entry_point: compiled attribute access: obj.method(), attribute(obj,'method',[args]), any access carrying arguments
collection higher-order methods from a template (items.filter('x'), items.each('x'))
paginator calls from a template (paginator.through('x'), paginator.render())

O3_reason_to_dismiss: checkMethodAllowed already receives the method name of every template call, so the policy file looks like the whole protection; a Twig compiler node visitor reads as framework plumbing rather than security code, and a solver who never reproduces a callable-argument case will not realise the policy is blind to arguments.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Collections and paginators must keep working normally in themes: iteration ({% for x in this.theme.listPages() %}), indexing, |length, {{ collection }}, and Twig's own arrow-function filters (items|map(v => v ~ '!')) must still render; blocking or freezing every Enumerable/Paginator method, or casting property access as well as method calls, breaks ordinary theme rendering.

O6_input_shapes: plain method call on an object (model.saveQuietly(), this.theme.writeConfig({...}))
method reached through PHP __call forwarding (model.increment('price',99999), model.when(1,'phpinfo') -> Eloquent Builder -> Query Builder)
method reached through the built-in attribute() function, which compiles to an ANY_CALL carrying arguments
callable argument to a collection higher-order method, as a plain string (items.filter('is_numeric')), as a nested array, and via attribute()
property access with no arguments ({{ model.title }}), which must stay unwrapped and un-cast

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Halcyon/theme-file model __call forwards to the Halcyon Builder, but $blockedForwarders models only Eloquent (Model, Builder, Relation), so Builder-only write methods (insert, truncate) stay reachable as this.page.<method>() while their siblings on HalcyonModel are blocked
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the Halcyon model already has its own blocklist entry, so the layer looks covered, and a template editor writing theme files is a neighbouring feature rather than the reported model-save PoC
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, one file away from the policy (cms classes -> system twig)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: compiled CMS Twig templates cached under storage/cms/twig were compiled with the old node tree and keep calling CoreExtension::getAttribute directly; the fix adds no cache invalidation, so the new node visitor never runs for already-cached pages, layouts and partials
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: auto_reload is on and cache clearing at upgrade is assumed, so this reads as an operations concern, not part of the security fix
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another module (cms ServiceProvider vs system twig policy) and its cache helper

O8b_injection_room.sibling: one more $blockedForwarders entry for a class whose __call proxies elsewhere (e.g. Winter\Storm\Halcyon\Model -> Builder, SessionManager -> Store)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix already models forwarding for three Eloquent classes in exactly this one-line style, so a maintainer adding a fourth is in-pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Safe* proxy for another callable-taking framework object, cast in castMethodObjectToSafeObject()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix's own comment says the policy cannot see method arguments, so the proxy-plus-cast pattern is the established answer for that class of sink

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another Controller method that re-enters rendering or assets (renderComponent, addComponent, getPageObject) added to the Controller blocklist
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix adds run/combineAssets/renderPartial/renderContent to that blocklist with a comment about nested page cycles, so a neighbour of the same kind is plausible

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another theme write path (a second writeConfig-like method, or the custom-data model's save path) added to the Theme blocklist
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: writeConfig and removeCustomData were added to the Theme blocklist by this very fix

O9_family: protection-mechanism bypass (CWE-693): Twig sandbox / blocklist escape leading to PHP code execution, theme-file writes and unrestricted database writes

O10_build.toolchain: PHP >= 8.1, Composer (Laravel 9, Twig 3, PHPUnit ^9.5); vendor/ is not committed, so composer install is required before anything runs
O10_build.project_tests: modules/system/tests/twig/SecurityPolicyTest.php (PHPUnit, suite defined in modules/system/phpunit.xml) renders real Twig through a Cms\Classes\Controller and covers method blocking, session allowlist and datasource blocking; config/testing/cms.php:76 sets twigNoCache so no compiled-template cache and no database are needed for these cases

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: add the missing method names to the SecurityPolicy blocklist (saveQuietly, forceFill, writeConfig, increment, when...) and stop as soon as the reported PoC no longer renders PHP

out_of_scope_notes: Client-side eval() hits under modules/*/assets (AJAX framework, ace editor) are unrelated to this advisory and were not pursued.
unverified: vendor/ is absent at the pinned commit (winter/storm, twig, laravel are Composer dependencies), so Halcyon Builder's method set and whether Winter\Storm\Halcyon\Model::__call forwards to it could not be read; O8 route 1 rests on modules/cms/classes/CmsCompoundObject.php:484 plus the fix diff's own forwarder map.
Assumed Twig 3 rejects string callables for the filter/map/sort/reduce filters (so those are not additional callable-input routes); vendor Twig source was not available to confirm.
Repository size in MB could not be measured without a shell, so tiny_repo/giant_repo were not assessed (O4.repo_mb is null).

Published Winter docs and third-party write-ups are not readable offline, so O13 and the protection_documented_without_exceptions flag (left off) are judgement calls; the in-repo policy comment at modules/system/twig/SecurityPolicy.php:20 says it blocks 'certain methods', i.e. a blocklist with an allowlist exception, not a no-exceptions rule.
